[CHANNEL: ARJUN] Explain how to debug high WebSocket latency on Windows cleanly.

Verdict: Isolate capture vs network transport first. 1) Measure `get_screen_capture_jpeg` (`mss` + OpenCV `imencode` should stay under 20ms). 2) Ensure `pyautogui.PAUSE = 0` so input calls don't sleep 100ms each. 3) Edge case: if on mobile data, Render adds internet RTT—use Direct LAN WebSocket (`ws://<ip>:8765/ws`) on 5GHz Wi-Fi.
